headline: SPR Auto Technologies submits postal ballot scrutinizer report and voting results to exchanges
hook: Postal ballot voting results now official
summary: SPR Auto Technologies Limited has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. This routine corporate filing concludes the shareholder voting process for the resolutions put forth by the company. Shareholders and investors can review the outcome of the postal ballot on the exchange portals. The filing ensures compliance with regulatory disclosure norms for listed entities.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate price impact.

headline: HBL Engineering and three other stocks enter StockEdge RSI uptrend scan
hook: Four stocks show rising technical momentum
summary: HBL Engineering, Authum Investment & Infrastructure, SPR Auto Technologies, and Thangamayil Jewellery appeared in StockEdge's RSI Trending Up scan on October 16. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) scan tracks equities showing increasing price momentum. Technical scans help traders identify short-term momentum shifts across listed companies.
why_it_matters: Technical scanner highlights short-term momentum changes for traders.

headline: SPR Auto files status of outstanding non-convertible debentures
hook: Routine debt disclosure for SPR Auto
summary: SPR Auto Technologies Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure to the NSE regarding its outstanding non-convertible debentures (NCDs). The filing details the specific ISINs for debt issued on a private placement basis as of September 30, 2026. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing required for companies with listed debt instruments.
